about: Vampire-werewolf hybrid horror (Act III hybrids): wolf skull muzzle splitting into a vampire jaw, matted black-grey fur over pale corpse skin, exposed ribs, elongated multi-jointed arms with long claws, digitigrade legs, bone spurs, crimson veins, red eyes.

model.notes: Tripo text-to-3D (standard, 38.2k triangles, PBR: albedo, metallic-roughness, normal), turned -90 degrees about Y to face +Z, feet at y=0, scaled to 2.8 m tall (2.7 m wide in its A-pose). Texture imports must be Lossy (WebP), never VRAM. Add an emissive red term on the veins (mask from the albedo's red channel) for the 'crimson glow'.

rigged.notes: Meshy auto-rig of the same mesh (24-bone humanoid skeleton), stripped with strip_rig_glb.gd 'mesh' mode (no textures; re-apply the PBR material from abomination.glb). In a .gdignore folder: read it with GLTFDocument. The digitigrade legs and long arms rig acceptably; the arms stretch at the extremes of the slam, which suits the creature.

clips.notes: rears up with an arm overhead (0.4-1.3 s), then smashes the ground at about 1.67 s: spawn the shockwave and the boss_slam SFX there.
reaches out and grabs (about 0.6-1.2 s), hoists the victim overhead (1.5-3.2 s) and hurls it down at about 3.5 s. Attach Sol to the right hand during the hold for a grab attack.
throws both arms up and flexes, a chest-out bellow. Short; good for the intro or phase change. Zombie_Scream (386, used by the werewolf) is a longer alternative on this skeleton too.
